reviewScope: Black Whale vessel, spatial, access, operational, structural and scale evidence only

pass1.method: Full-page visual sweep of all 19 ordered pages

pass2.method: Full-resolution verification of crowd halls, service corridors, cargo storage, stairs, food service and administrative spaces

retainedPanels.subject: Dense public crowd compartment
retainedPanels.visualDescription: A dense crowd occupies a very large interior public compartment.

retainedPanels.subject: Cargo-filled storage room
retainedPanels.visualDescription: A large room contains many stacked crates and open work aisles.
modelingPermissions: Represent cargo storage density and aisles
modelingProhibitions: Do not count unseen crates or derive dimensions

retainedPanels.subject: Deep industrial service passage
retainedPanels.visualDescription: A deep industrial passage extends through repeated structural bays and exposed services.

retainedPanels.subject: Food-service zone

modelingProhibitions: Do not infer exact kitchen layout

evidence.claim: A dense crowd occupies a very large interior public compartment.
A plain doorway connects a small room to a corridor.
A narrow corridor with simple walls and doors supports lower-tier circulation.
A visible numeral marks a plain room threshold.
A stair or inclined route connects interior levels.
A heavy doorway opens into a service passage.
A large room contains many stacked crates and open work aisles.
A long worn corridor shows exposed services and repeated openings.
A deep industrial passage extends through repeated structural bays.
A broad deteriorated corridor supports group movement.
Uniformed personnel supervise movement inside a large occupied space.
Prepared food and serving trays establish a shipboard catering or communal-service zone.
A table-based office or registration area supports seated and standing staff.
A long compartment with exposed overhead services supports lower-tier circulation.
Groups move through a more finished public passage distinct from industrial routes.

contradictionsAndQuarantines.subject: Service-route continuity
contradictionsAndQuarantines.rule: Repeated industrial corridors establish a network class but not exact connectivity.

contradictionsAndQuarantines.subject: Cargo-room dimensions
contradictionsAndQuarantines.rule: Crate stacks provide scale cues but not exact room dimensions.

contradictionsAndQuarantines.subject: Public-hall identity
contradictionsAndQuarantines.rule: Crowd scenes confirm a large public compartment; exact tier and sector require independent confirmation.

unresolvedQuestions: What sector contains the cargo room?
Which tier contains the public hall?

excludedMaterial.reason: Excluded pages do not independently establish ship evidence.
